details:
Description

Since Nov 4, 2026, every avatar becomes an error avatar on my home connection. It happens with public sample avatars too, and on a second account. Avatars should download and display normally.

Log (repeats for every avatar, none are downloaded):

Remote server closed the connection before sending response header! Previous request state: Processing. Connection state: WaitForRecycle

[AnalysisReport] Failed to get avatar analysis report.

[AssetBundleDownloadManager] Avatar did not pass initial checks and won't be downloaded: AssetBundleFailedServerSideChecks

Download Error: An error occured while checking analysis results. | 10

AmplitudeAPI Experiments requests fail in-game with the same error.

Submitting this bug report from in-game also failed on SoftBank Air with the same error (BugReport submit returned no postUrl). This report was sent over mobile tethering instead.

Network: fails on SoftBank Air (5G home router, AS17676). The same PC works on mobile tethering. On SoftBank Air, curl from the same PC reaches api.vrchat.cloud normally, including the analysis endpoint (401 without login), so the failure seems limited to requests made by the VRChat client.

Other users appear to be reporting the same symptoms on X.

Reproduction Steps

1. Connect the PC to SoftBank Air.

2. Start VRChat and switch to any avatar, including public sample avatars.

3. The avatar becomes an error avatar. The log shows the errors above.

Happens every time, also after reinstalling, clearing the cache, restarting the PC and router, re-login, a second account, and removing security software.

Workaround: connect the PC to mobile tethering.
